description.en: Creates a low-detail cutscene model for a match roster member, looked up by param ID, and — unless suppressed — also creates its matching bustup portrait.
Name to assign the created model.
Whether the character is displayed on the "upper" match side.
Param ID of the match roster member to create.
Optional team slot the member belongs to (defaults to 2).
Optional; when true, skips creating the matching bustup portrait (defaults to false).
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a low-detail cutscene model for a match roster member
local hTsurugiL = CreateEvLowMdlForMatch("tsurugiL", isEvUpperDisp, "para_cp0010");
